title: Shave the mammoth
author: AdPlenty7002
selftext:
A simple, relaxing little game I made over the weekend, just to give Fable 5.2 a little test drive. The game is about exactly what the name is: you shave a woolly mammoth - someone has to. 

Free on Itch [here](https://pallkvaran.itch.io/shave-the-mammoth).

Start with a pair of small scissors. Cut some hair, sell it to Mortimer the vulture for fine toupee making, and spend the gold at Gnorman's stall.

\- Shears, garden clippers, and electric shears, broom, vacuum, ladder or a jet pack

\- Lemmings for hire, cave men for hire, and ten novelty items you may use at your own peril.

Be warned that under the coat exist various things you cannot unsee.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/AdPlenty7002 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.
